text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon shows up before the concert, seemingly deep in thought.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, waiting in the wings, Smart Falcon gives a pep talk to a nervous-looking Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To get on stage is to believe in the power of song to move hearts. Our second concert begins!
